data.title: Notice to Postpone Listing of QuarkChain (QKC)
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Due to an insufficient amount of QKC tokens deposited, Binance will postpone the listing of QuarkChain (QKC) until further notice. We will keep QKC deposits and withdrawals open and provide a further announcement prior to listing. Thank you for your understanding.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2018/06/04

 

Find us on

Telegram: https://t.me/binanceexchange
Twitter: https://twitter.com/binance
